results: 1. limb power and wasting: distal weakness - 4+/5 in the upper limbs, 3/5 in the lower limbs bilaterally
2. foot deformity (pes cavus): pes cavus present
3. genetic testing (targeted panel or exome): heterozygous deletion in MPZ and MFN2; ambiguous copy number decrease in PMP22 exons 2-3 - CMT2A
4. nerve conduction studies / EMG: moderate to severe motor polyneuropathy, axonal more than demyelinating
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Charcot–Marie–Tooth disease type 2A (CMT2A), an autosomal-dominant axonal hereditary motor-sensory polyneuropathy caused by a heterozygous pathogenic MFN2 deletion/variant.

Alternative: Charcot–Marie–Tooth disease type 1B due to the heterozygous MPZ deletion.

Alternative: Hereditary neuropathy with liability to pressure palsies due to a PMP22 exon 2–3 deletion.

Alternative: A combined or blended hereditary neuropathy from pathogenic variants involving both MFN2 and MPZ.
dx: Charcot–Marie–Tooth disease type 2A (CMT2A), an autosomal-dominant axonal hereditary motor-sensory polyneuropathy caused by a heterozygous pathogenic MFN2 deletion/variant.
